$description: SE Pipeline artifact manifest — tracks every artifact produced by every skill, enabling cross-session resume and version consistency checks.

requirements.notes: Output of requirements-decompose. Files appear in docs/requirements/ with REQ-XXX IDs.

architecture_system.notes: Output of architecture-design. Files appear in docs/architecture/ with MOD-XXX and IF-XXX IDs.

architecture_software.notes: Output of software-architecture-design. RTOS thread model, memory budget, IPC design.

architecture_hardware.notes: Output of hardware-architecture-design. Pin assignments, voltage domains, PCB constraints.

spec_system.notes: Output of spec-authoring. SOD, HW-SW IF Spec, Test Plan in docs/spec/.

spec_software_detailed.notes: Output of software-detailed-design. Function signatures, state machines, data structures.

spec_hardware_detailed.notes: Output of hardware-detailed-design. Schematic guidance, BOM constraints, PCB rules.

spec_algorithm.notes: Output of algorithm-design. Signal processing chains, control loops, calibration.

review_design.notes: Output of design-review. Four-lens adversarial review report in docs/reviews/.

review_requirements.notes: Output of requirements-review. Checklist-based requirements review report.

review_code.notes: Output of code-static-review. Static analysis report against coding standards.

review_test_plan.notes: Output of test-plan-review. Test plan completeness and compliance review.

review_test_report.notes: Output of test-report-review. Test report correctness and traceability review.

review_release.notes: Output of release-review. Release readiness report (binaries, notes, test reports).

traceability.notes: Output of traceability-matrix. Cross-artifact gap analysis and coverage report.

usage.update_on_skill_completion: After each skill produces an artifact, add the file path to the 'files' array and update 'version' and 'status' to 'produced'.
usage.check_on_pipeline_start: On session start, read this file to determine current phase. If this file exists and has artifacts, skip directory-only phase detection.
usage.version_consistency: Before running any downstream skill, verify that all 'depends_on' artifacts are in 'produced' status. If not, surface the missing prerequisite.
